summary: Splits get_resolver into a thin wrapper that normalizes urlconf=None to settings.ROOT_URLCONF before delegating to an lru_cache'd _get_resolver, so all callers share one cached URLResolver regardless of whether set_urlconf has run. This is exactly the maintainer-proposed fix and correctly resolves the duplicate-_populate problem with no regression or compatibility risk.

issues.description: PEP8: only one blank line separates get_resolver and the new _get_resolver; Django requires two blank lines between top-level definitions. Stylistic nit, not merge-blocking.
